title: Bicycle Bell
author: IENBA
changes: A real bicycle bell going 'ring-ring, ring-ring'. Trimmed to 0.00–2.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.6 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (Zoom H4n, Sennheiser MKE 600).
